ranks: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (TMT, 2026-03-06): the rest of the set; Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander (ECC, 2026-01-23): the rest of the set

blocked.name: April O'Neil, Hacktivist
blocked.why: "Draw a card for each card type among spells you've cast this turn": the castThisTurn amount counts spells or reads their greatest mana value, but can't count the card types among them.

blocked.name: Bot Bashing Time
blocked.why: "If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead": no effect sets up a this-turn die-to-exile replacement on a target (the ruling: for any reason, not only this damage).

blocked.name: Brilliance Unleashed
blocked.why: Mode 2's "return it to the battlefield and it's a 3/3 Robot artifact creature with flying" must hold as it enters; put-onto-battlefield has setTypes/addSubtypes but no added creature type, base P/T or keyword, and animating after it enters would miss creature-enters triggers.

blocked.name: Broadcast Takeover
blocked.why: "Untap them. They gain haste" must reach exactly the artifacts gain-control-all just took; no ThisWayKind or filter names them (an artifact you already controlled would be untapped too), and untapping before the control change is observable through becomes-untapped triggers.

blocked.name: Courier of Comestibles
blocked.why: "If you don't put a card into your hand this way, create a Food token" has to cover both declining the may-search and searching but finding nothing; may's else covers only declining, and there is no this-way kind for cards put into a hand by a search.

blocked.name: Don & Raph, Hard Science
blocked.why: "The next noncreature spell you cast this turn has affinity for artifacts" — player-effect reduceSpells reduces every matching spell for the turn, not only the next one, and nothing grants affinity to just the next spell (stacking per resolution, the ruling).

blocked.name: Eventide's Shadow
blocked.why: "Remove any number of counters from among permanents on the battlefield" (any kinds, anyone's permanents) has no effect — remove-counter takes one kind on one target — and nothing counts the counters removed this way for the draw and life loss.

blocked.name: Ferrafor, Young Yew
blocked.why: "Create Saprolings equal to the number of counters among creatures target player controls": an aggregate sums one counter kind (AggregateOf.counters) and has no forTarget, so every-kind counters among a target player's creatures can't be counted (its {T} double-counters ability alone is authorable).

blocked.name: Kitsune, Dragon's Daughter
blocked.why: "Exchange control of two other target creatures controlled by different players": there is no exchange-control effect.

blocked.name: Michelangelo's Technique
blocked.why: "Put up to two creature cards with total mana value 6 or less from among them onto the battlefield": look-and-choose has no total-mana-value cap on its picks.

blocked.name: Mondo Gecko
blocked.why: "Becomes the color of your choice and gains hexproof from that color" — no color-setting effect, no color choice on resolution, and hexproof from a color isn't modeled.

blocked.name: North Wind Avatar
blocked.why: "You may put a card you own from outside the game into your hand": no sideboard / outside-the-game zone is modeled.

blocked.name: Novel Nunchaku
blocked.why: The reflexive "equipped creature fights up to one target creature an opponent controls": fight's sides are EffectTargetRefs, and none names the creature the source Equipment is attached to (the reflexive ability's own target is only the opponent's creature).

blocked.name: Raphael, Most Attitude
blocked.why: "Whenever Raphael attacks, until end of turn, you may play a card exiled with Raphael": no effect grants a play permission over the cards linked to the source (the alliance exile would need exile-from-library with a link and no permission of its own).

blocked.name: Ray Fillet, Man Ray
blocked.why: "{2}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Draw a card" — the removeCounter cost only removes from the source, not from a chosen creature you control.

blocked.name: Renet, Temporal Apprentice
blocked.why: "Return each other nonland permanent that entered this turn" — return-to-hand-all has no exceptSource and CardFilter can't exclude the source, so Renet (which entered this turn) would bounce itself.

blocked.name: Retro-Mutation
blocked.why: "Enchanted creature ... loses all abilities" is an Aura's static, and losing all abilities exists only as an effect modifier (lose-abilities / animate's loseAbilities), not a StaticAbility field; the Turtle type and 0/1 base P/T would be setSubtypes/setBasePt.

blocked.name: Return to the Sewers
blocked.why: "Target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library": put-on-library takes a fixed position, and nothing hands the top-or-bottom choice to the target's owner (who may be an opponent).

blocked.name: Stomped by the Foot
blocked.why: "Kicker—Sacrifice an artifact or creature" — kicker.cost is mana only; no sacrifice kicker.

blocked.name: The Last Ronin
blocked.why: Chapter III, "Whenever a creature you control attacks alone this turn, ...": a delayed triggered ability that repeats for the rest of the turn and reaches creatures that arrive later isn't expressible (grant-triggered-all would lock in the current creatures).

blocked.name: Turtles in Time
blocked.why: "Each player may shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, then each player who does draws seven cards" fits each-player-may with ifDid draw 7, but no effect shuffles a player's hand and graveyard into their library.

blocked.name: Uneasy Alliance
blocked.why: "{5}, Sacrifice this Aura: Exile enchanted creature" — no EffectTargetRef names the creature the (sacrificed) Aura enchanted.
